t.why: The African Union is headquartered in its capital, Addis Ababa. It is at odds with Egypt over a huge dam on the Nile.
t.rel: Its desire for access to the sea has raised tension with Eritrea and Somalia. It signed a peace deal with Eritrea in 2018 after their 1998 border war, but relations have soured again. It is at odds with Egypt and Sudan over its huge Nile dam.
t.korea: The only African country that sent ground troops to the Korean War.
t.know: Ethiopia uses its own 13-month calendar, which runs seven to eight years behind the Western one.
t.etext: Coffee is its signature export, along with flowers and sesame. Ethiopian Airlines is considered Africa's largest airline. Landlocked, it relies on the port of Djibouti, and foreign-currency shortages and the aftermath of civil war weigh heavily.
